subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Vehement
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word '**Vehement**' means showing very strong (often negative) feelings, especially anger.(उग्र, प्रबल)

 
 
• **Example **- The storm was so **vehement **that it caused widespread damage.
 
 
 
• '**Mild**' means not strong; not very bad; gentle, soft, or not severe.(हल्का, सौम्य)
 
 
• **Example **- He was **mild **and courteous in his dealings with others.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the antonym of '**Vehement**' is '**Mild**'.

Therefore, the **correct answer** is '**Mild**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences.

 
• **Reliable **(भरोसेमंद) - That you can trust; trustworthy, dependable, or consistent.

 
 
• **Example **- We need to find a **reliable **company to supply the goods.

 
 
 
 
• **Passionate **(जुनूनी) - Showing or caused by very strong feelings.
 
 
• **Example **- Football ran through his veins and he was very **passionate **about it.

 
 
 
 
• **Smashed **(टूट गया) - To break something, or to be broken violently and noisily into many pieces.
 
 
• **Example **- The vase was **smashed **into a thousand pieces.
